name: Towdee Mac
editorial_article: Towdee Mac, born Lerothodi Moagi, is a South African music producer, songwriter, and composer recognized for his contributions to the local hip-hop landscape, particularly the Motswako movement. His work involves collaborations with artists such as foi and Uncle Jorddy, notably featured on the track 'Never Alone'. In addition to his creative output, he has appeared on platforms like The Tswyza Show to discuss the evolving state of South African hip hop. Beyond production and songwriting, he advocates for the education of South African youth regarding music rights, frequently sharing insights on the mechanics of music production through media platforms.
